definitions.gloss: cool and refreshing; fresh and invigorating
definitions.explanation: Describes a pleasantly cool and refreshing sensation, often associated with clean air, clear water, or a cooling breeze.

examples.japanese: {清涼|せいりょう}な{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いた。
{清涼|せいりょう}{飲料水|いんりょうすい}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a refreshing soft drink.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{空気|くうき}は{清涼|せいりょう}で、{都会|とかい}の{疲|つか}れが{一気|いっき}に{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: The mountain air was cool and refreshing, and the fatigue of city life vanished all at once.

notes:
Conveys a clean, pure coolness that is invigorating rather than merely cold. Most commonly encountered in the compound {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい} (soft drinks/refreshing beverages), which is an official product category in Japan. As a standalone adjective, it has a somewhat literary or formal tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}: soft drink, refreshing beverage
- {清涼|せいりょう}{感|かん}: refreshing sensation
- {清涼|せいりょう}な{空気|くうき}: crisp, fresh air
- {清涼|せいりょう}な{風|かぜ}: refreshing breeze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {爽|さわ}やか: refreshing, invigorating — more common in everyday speech and broader in usage
- {涼|すず}しい: cool — describes temperature directly, less emphasis on purity
- {冷涼|れいりょう}: cool (climate) — used mainly for weather and climate descriptions
